Potassium manganate(VII), KMnO4, is a compound with a range of different uses.
What does (VII) indicate about this compound?
A
The oxidation number of potassium in this compound is –7.
B
The oxidation number of potassium in this compound is +7.
C
The oxidation number of manganese in this compound is –7.
D
The oxidation number of manganese in this compound is +7.
